scope: Make DRW_SectionObject DWG encoding transactional across body, detached strings, and handle streams, and test allocation-failure rollback with same-object retry.

changes: Run common header, section name, plane and height fields, indicator color, vertex/back-line vectors, handles, and oType mutation through encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
Keep existing version and value validation and field ordering unchanged.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores oType; retrying the same object with the same buffers reproduces clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 3,330 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, ARCALIGNEDTEXT, LIGHT, and SECTIONOBJECT; 6 HATCH-family/ARCALIGNEDTEXT versions, 3 MLEADER versions and 4 LIGHT/SECTIONOBJECT versions; 145 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: The generated SECTIONOBJECT includes a detached section name, plane direction, positive and negative heights, indicator color, two section vertices, one back-line vertex, and a section-settings handle.
Writer revisions AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 are exercised with five body/string/handle alias layouts per revision.
Each injected allocation failure checks caller-stream rollback, oType restoration and exact same-object/same-buffer retry.
limitations: This establishes transaction/failure behavior only, not SECTIONOBJECT wire semantics, 3D section evaluation, native consumer behavior, or source-producer breadth.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
